help.guides.getting-started.title: Kutanga neAWA
help.guides.getting-started.text: Tsvaga chidzitiro chako chepakutanga, karenda, magazini, zvinangwa uye zvokunamata.
help.guides.cycle.title: Kutevera kutenderera
help.guides.cycle.text: Ronga nguva yako, kuyerera kwako, uye tarisa kufungidzira kwako.
help.guides.conceive.title: Kuedza kubata pamuviri
help.guides.conceive.text: Ongorora kubereka, ovulation, basal tembiricha, cervical mucus uye LH bvunzo.
help.guides.contraception.title: Kudzivirira pamuviri
help.guides.contraception.text: Gadzirisa nzira yako, zviyeuchidzo, mishonga yakarasika uye nhoroondo yekutora.
help.guides.irregular.title: Zvikamu zvisina kurongeka / PCOS
help.guides.irregular.text: Tarisa nguva dzisina kurongeka, acne, kukura kwebvudzi, uremu uye zviratidzo zvakabatana.
help.guides.menopause.title: Perimenopause / Menopause
help.guides.menopause.text: Ona kupisa, kurara, kuneta, mafungiro uye kurapwa kwehomoni.
help.guides.pregnancy.title: Kutevera pamuviri
help.guides.pregnancy.text: Tarisa zuva rako rokuberekwa, vhiki, nguva dzako, bvunzo uye zviratidzo.
help.guides.postpartum.title: Kuzvarwa
help.guides.postpartum.text: Tarisa lochia, kudzoka kwechitenderera, kuyamwisa, kurara, mafungiro uye kupora.
help.guides.loss.title: Pashure pokubvisa pamuviri
help.guides.loss.text: Ona kuti ropa rako riri kubuda sei, kuti zviratidzo zvako zviri kuitika sei, uye kuti nguva yako iri kudzoka sei.
help.guides.calendar.title: Kushandisa karenda
help.guides.calendar.text: Nzwisisa nguva, kufanotaura, zviratidzo, uye kuratidzwa kwechiGregorian / Hijri.
help.guides.journal.title: Kuzadza zuva rako
help.guides.journal.text: Rondedzero yezviratidzo, mafungiro, kurara, kuita zvinhu, manotsi uye ukama hwepedyo.
help.guides.spiritual.title: Kushandisa zviratidzo zvomudzimu
help.guides.spiritual.text: Tsvaga karenda yeHijri, kuchena, munyengetero, kutsanya, qadaa uye nifas.
help.guides.privacy.title: Kuvanzika & Data
help.guides.privacy.text: Gadzirisa kuchengeteka, nzira yakanyarara, kutumira kunze, encryption uye kudzima mashoko.
